verdict.rationale: Rippling ships native device management in the same platform as identity. Its docs cover lifecycle automation for Apple and Windows devices, zero-touch deployment, and setup and configuration across macOS, Windows, iOS and iPadOS. Custom security policies can be enforced on user and device attributes, unifying identity and devices. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of remote lock/wipe tied to offboarding or identity events, detail on enrollment mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
